description: This file provides localization (i18n) strings for the Select2 library in Latvian language, version 4.0.6-rc.1.

methods.name: inputTooLong
methods.description: Returns Latvian message prompting to remove excess characters when input is too long.

methods.name: inputTooShort
methods.description: Returns Latvian message prompting to add more characters when input is too short.

methods.name: loadingMore
methods.description: Returns Latvian message indicating data is loading.

methods.name: maximumSelected
methods.description: Returns Latvian message indicating the maximum number of selectable items has been reached.

methods.name: noResults
methods.description: Returns Latvian message indicating no search results were found.

methods.name: searching
methods.description: Returns Latvian message indicating search is in progress.
